findings.fix: Keep the block in this file (as round 1 asked) but declare it under the one existing namespace: replace `namespace Bilin` with a fully-qualified `namespace EpsilonEridani.QFT.Scattering.DIS.Kinematics.Bilin` block placed before `namespace Tensors`, so all `Bilin.*` names live in a single namespace and the elastic module needs only one `open`.
findings.issue: `namespace Bilin` opened here is a *second* namespace with that leaf name: the `Bilin` abbrev and its generic API already live in `EpsilonEridani.QFT.Scattering.DIS.Kinematics.Bilin` (Kinematics/Basic.lean:34,36). The same prefix now means two things in this one file — line 577 `Bilin.apply_eq_zero_of_apply_eq_self_of_apply_eq_neg` resolves to `Kinematics.Bilin`, line 503 `Bilin.IsPairStabilizer` to `Tensors.Bilin` — and consumers must open both (Elastic/FormFactor/Basic.lean:106-108 opens `Kinematics (Bilin)` and `Tensors (Bilin.IsPairStabilizer …)`).

findings.evidence: Line 137-138 statement vs line 134 docstring "Two vectors with non-zero Gram determinant split `V`"; Mathlib has no `gram` declaration to anchor the abbreviated reading.
findings.fix: Rename to `isSpectatorSplit_of_gramDet_ne_zero` (update the use at Tensors/Basic.lean:733 and the PR description's prose).
findings.issue: `isSpectatorSplit_of_gram_ne_zero` names the hypothesis `g a a * g b b - g a b * g b a ≠ 0`, which is the non-vanishing of the Gram *determinant*, not of a Gram matrix/form; the docstring (line 134) says "non-zero Gram determinant".

findings.evidence: grep for primed declarations in `EpsilonEridani/` returns only variants (`sum_sum_erase_const'`, `lie_jacobi'`, `invariants_mem_kinematicDomain_iff'`, …) plus this one; `DisKinematics` fields `pPrime`/`kPrime` at DIS/Kinematics/Basic.lean:68,72.
findings.issue: `def pWit'` uses a prime to denote a different object (the outgoing momentum), whereas in Mathlib and everywhere else in this repo a primed name is a variant of the unprimed declaration; it is the only primed `def` in `EpsilonEridani/`. The repo's own convention for an outgoing momentum spells it out (`DisKinematics.pPrime`, `kPrime`). It also propagates into compound names like `gWit_pWit'_sub_pWit_self_eq_neg_twelve` (line 277).

summary: Names mostly describe their conclusions in standard terminology, but the PR creates a second namespace named `Bilin` for the API of the same abbreviation, so `Bilin.foo` now resolves to two different namespaces inside one file; two smaller naming slips (`gram` for a Gram determinant, a primed `def`).
